'''Hamar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who served as a [[Quartermaster/Legends|supply officer]] for [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Hamar.png|thumb|200px|Hamar former appearance]]
Hamar first appeared as a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a level 50 Battlemaster PVP Gear vendor. He was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> He was later re-added to the game, as a human, but doesn't serve any function anymore.
